captions.detailed: A dual-actuation dropper seatpost made from uniform light grey material. It features a long, cylindrical outer tube topped with a slightly wider collar ring, from which two small side-lever actuators extend on opposite sides. A telescoping inner tube slides vertically (prismatically) inside the outer tube, capped at its top by a rectangular box representing a saddle clamp interface. The two side levers pivot independently on revolute hinges relative to the central collar ring.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a dual-actuation dropper seatpost with a uniform light grey finish. The assembly must include a main outer tube, a telescoping inner tube that slides prismatically inside the outer tube, a rectangular top clamp, and two opposite-facing side levers that pivot on revolute joints at the collar.
captions.factory: Construct the outer tube using a cylinder and a wider concentric cylinder for the collar. Model the inner tube as a narrower cylinder capped with a rectangular box. Create the two side levers using a combination of small cylinders for the hinge pins and boxes for the levers. Define a prismatic joint along the Z-axis between the outer and inner tubes, and two revolute joints along the Y-axis for the left and right levers pivoting on the collar.
